new.title: New item
new.description: It starts as a draft 1.0; publish it when its form and blueprint are ready.
new.name: Name
new.slugHint: In URLs and YAML: lower case, digits and dashes. It can't change later.
new.summaryHint: One line on the catalog's card.

import.title: Import an item
import.description: Paste or open an item exported as YAML. It comes in as a draft; nothing is published.

items.title: Items
items.description: What people can request, and the version of each they get.
items.noMatchBody: Nothing in the catalog has this name, kind, category and state.
items.emptyBody: An item is what people request: a VM, an AWX job, a workflow, or several of them together.
items.publishUnsaved: Publish: the designer has changes to save
items.publishWaits: Publish {{number}}: waits for the change running
items.withdrawBody: Nobody can request it until a version is published again. {{stays}}
items.deleteBody_one: The item and its {{count}} version are deleted. This can't be undone.
items.deleteBody_other: The item and its {{count}} versions are deleted. This can't be undone.
items.deleteConsequences: Nobody has requested it, so no deployment depends on it. It is open to {{openTo}}.
items.deleteConsequencesPublished: Nobody has requested it, so no deployment depends on it. It is open to {{openTo}}, and leaves their catalog.
items.staysMany: Versions {{versions}} stay, to roll back to.
items.staysOne: Version {{number}} stays, to roll back to.
items.builtNoneOne: No deployment was built from it.
items.builtNoneMany: No deployment was built from them.
items.builtOne_one: The {{count}} deployment built from it keeps running, with their day-2 actions.
items.builtOne_other: The {{count}} deployments built from it keep running, with their day-2 actions.
items.builtMany_one: The {{count}} deployment built from them keeps running, with their day-2 actions.
items.builtMany_other: The {{count}} deployments built from them keep running, with their day-2 actions.

categories.sheetDescription: The catalog groups its items by category, in this order.
categories.keyHint: In items' YAML: lower case, digits and dashes. It can't change later.
categories.name: Name
categories.title: Categories
categories.description: How the catalog groups its items.
categories.emptyBody: Every item is in a category: add one before the first item.
categories.removeBody: It leaves the catalog's list of categories.

secrets.sheetDescription: Stored encrypted. Its value is never shown again. A REST value source or call names it, cloud-init user data reads it as {{userData}}, an AWX step as {{awx}}.
secrets.name: Name
secrets.nameHint: Lower case letters, digits and dashes.
secrets.projectHint: A project's own secret is opened by its requests rather than the global one of the same name. Other projects never open it.
secrets.valueHint: The new value replaces the stored one at once, in every item that uses it.
secrets.shadows: Opened instead of the global one
secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.panelDescription: What REST value sources and calls sign in with, and what Windows guests, cloud-init and AWX steps are given.
secrets.emptyBody: Store the token or password a REST call, a guest or an AWX step needs; its value is never shown again.
secrets.removeBody: Its value is deleted. Storing a secret of the same name later doesn't bring it back.
secrets.removeUnused: No item or template uses it today.

needs.failing: rvav can't commit it: check the repository's settings and credentials.
needs.draft: The repository changed it: review the draft, then publish or discard it.
needs.conflict: rvav and the repository both changed it: choose which to keep.
needs.refused: The repository's file can't be imported: fix it there.
needs.deleted: The repository deleted it: rvav keeps the item.

git.sheetDescription: rvav commits each item's published version here, and reads the repository's changes back as drafts.
git.readComing: , and a read is on its way
git.committed: rvav's file will be committed over the repository's change
git.takenDraft: The repository's change is a draft
git.waiting: rvav's change will be committed at the next read of the repository.
git.refusedWhy: Why the repository's file was refused
git.ownDraft: The repository's change is draft {{number}}: review it in Versions, then publish it (rvav commits it back) or discard it (rvav's file is committed again).
git.deletedThere: The repository deleted the file: keep rvav's to add it back.
git.conflict: Keep rvav's file, committed over the repository's change; or take the repository's, as a draft (an open draft in rvav is discarded).
git.discardBody: The repository's change becomes the item's draft, in place of rvav's.
git.discardConsequences: What draft {{number}} changed is lost. The published version stays as it is.
git.fromToDraft: From rvav's file to the repository's draft
git.fromTo: From rvav's file to the repository's
git.changes: Changes from rvav's file to the repository's

sharing.projectsDescription: The projects whose catalog has it. Who may request it in each is below.
sharing.ownShares_one: {{count}} project keeps its own share, which adds to every project's.
sharing.ownShares_other: {{count}} projects keep their own share, which adds to every project's.
sharing.whoMayDescription: In each project, all the members who may request there, or only the users, groups and roles you choose. Shares add up.
sharing.notSharedBody: No project's catalog has it: nobody can request it. Share it with a project.
sharing.shareDescription: Pick a project, then who may request the item there.
sharing.projectEveryHint: Who may request it in each project, those made later included.
sharing.allMembersHint: everyone who may request in the project
sharing.chosenPeopleHint: the users, groups and roles below
sharing.oidcGroupHint: As the identity provider's token names it. Press Enter to add it.
sharing.projectRolesHint: Whoever holds one in the project, themselves or through a group.
sharing.pickOne: Who can request is shown for one project at a time: pick one.
sharing.whoCanFailed: Who can request couldn't be worked out.
sharing.alsoEverywhere: Also shared with every project: {{who}}. Shares add up.
sharing.notRequesters: {{names}} may not request in {{project}}: give them a role that may.
sharing.unseenGroup: Nobody rvav has seen is in {{group}} yet: check its name in the identity provider.

error.json: A list in [ ] or an object in { }.

variables.sheetDescription: Steps that run from then on read the value saved, in requests already running too. It isn't masked anywhere: store a password, a token or a key as a secret instead.
variables.groupHint: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, such as network.
variables.name: Name
variables.readAs: Steps and conditions read it as <expr/>.
variables.jsonHint: A list, such as {{example}}, or an object.
variables.title: Variables
variables.lead: Values that aren't secret and that several items share, such as a site's DNS servers. Composite steps and conditions read them as <expr/> each time they run. Store passwords and tokens as secrets instead.
variables.emptyEdit: Add a value several items share, such as a site's DNS servers, so that each reads it from one place.
variables.emptyRead: No value is shared between items yet.
variables.removeBody: Steps can no longer read it. Adding a variable of the same name later brings its use back.

wait.saving: The designer is still saving the draft.
wait.refused: The designer has changes the server refused or couldn't save: see the Form designer tab.
wait.yaml: Save or undo your changes to the YAML first.

item.refusedLines_one: A problem in its definition, shown on their lines.
item.refusedLines_other: {{count}} problems in its definition, shown on their lines.
item.refusedSteps_one: A problem in its definition, shown on their lines and steps.
item.refusedSteps_other: {{count}} problems in its definition, shown on their lines and steps.
item.draftMade: Draft {{number}} made from the published version
item.versionsLead: People request a published version: the newest, unless they pick another kept published. Requests and deployments keep the version they were made with.
item.publishSaveFirst: Publish {{number}}: save the draft's changes first
item.publishBesideSaveFirst: Publish {{number}} beside {{kept}}: save the draft's changes first
item.discardBody: Its changes are lost, in the form designer and the YAML alike.
item.discardFromGit: The draft came from the repository: rvav commits its own file there again.
item.discardNone: The item has no published version: nobody can request it.
item.frozen: Published and earlier versions never change: make a draft to edit.
item.designerPending: This shows the designer's changes, which the server hasn't saved yet; fix them here and save.

details.title: Details
details.lead: How the item shows in the catalog. Saved at once, in every version.
details.name: Name
details.tagsHint: Separated by commas. They also group the item's VMs in the AWX inventory.

item.leaveBody: Your changes to the definition are lost; the draft keeps what was last saved.

graph.notDrawn: A blueprint of kind {{kind}} isn't drawn
graph.yamlLine: The YAML doesn't parse at line {{line}}
graph.steps: Steps, in the order they run
graph.lastParsed: {{reason}}: the graph shows the definition as it last parsed.

groups.name: Name
groups.label: Label
groups.optionsHint: Separated by commas. Requesters choose one; none lets them type.
groups.helpHint: Shown under the field on the request form.
groups.inventory: A host variable in the AWX inventory
groups.changeLead: Saving makes version {{version}}. Items keep the version they name until their blueprint names this one.
groups.newLead: Inputs and constants several items share. An item's blueprint names a version of the group.
groups.keyHint: Blueprints name it, and bindings read its constants as <expr/>.
groups.inputsLead: Each joins the request form of the items naming the group, in a section of its own, as if the item declared it.
groups.constantsLead: Values the items' bindings read; requesters don't see them.
groups.title: Property groups
groups.lead: Inputs and constants several catalog items share. An item names a version of a group in its blueprint, as <blueprint/>; the group's inputs join its request form, and its bindings read the constants as <expr/>.
groups.emptyBody: Gather the inputs and values several items ask for or use, such as a cost centre or a DNS domain, once.
groups.deleteBody: Every version of the group is deleted.
groups.deleteConsequences: No published item uses it. A draft that names it is refused when next saved.

param.urlHint: On a host REST value sources may call. Read the parameters as {{expr}}.
param.bodyHint: Sent with POST. Read the parameters as {{expr}}.
param.secretHint: A stored secret's name: rvav sends it as a bearer token.
param.itemsHint: JSONPath to the list in the answer, such as $.items[*].
param.valueHint: JSONPath in each item to its value, such as $.id.
param.label: Label
param.labelHint: JSONPath in each item to what requesters see.
param.metaHint: JSONPath in each item to a detail shown under it.
param.parentHint: JSONPath in each item to its parent's value, for a tree. Empty for a flat list.
param.validHint: JSONPath to true or false in the answer. $.valid when empty.
param.messageHint: JSONPath to the refusal's message. $.message when empty.
param.errorsHint: JSONPath to messages by input, or a list of {field, message}. $.errors when empty.
param.optionsHint: A list of strings or of {value, label, meta}, from {{expr}}, environment, project and user.
param.checkHint: True, "" or {} when the form passes; false, a message, or {{shape}} when it doesn't.
param.celValueHint: One value, for a field that takes one rather than a choice.

library.noUse: No item's form names it yet.
library.changeLead: Saving makes version {{version}}, and gives each item that uses an earlier version a draft naming it, to review and publish.
library.newLead: A value source or a validation any item's form can name, giving its parameters from its inputs.
library.keyHint: Forms name the entry by its key, which doesn't change.
library.name: Name
library.purposeHint: Forms use it as one: it doesn't change.
library.searches: Searches by what the requester types (reads {{expr}})
library.messageHint: Shown when it refuses without saying why. A form's own message comes first.
library.parametersLead: What a form gives the entry, each as a CEL expression over its inputs, such as <expr/>.
library.label: Label
library.required: Required: without it, the entry doesn't run
library.testLead: Runs the entry as written, unsaved changes included, with these parameter values, as a form of this project and environment would.
library.projectHint: For project, and a REST call's secret of the project.
library.title: Form library
library.lead: Value sources and validations any item's form names by key and version, as a field's <expr/> or one of its validations. A form gives an entry's parameters as CEL over its inputs.
library.emptyBody: Write once what several forms ask a service, such as the CMDB's applications, or check before approval, such as an open cost centre.
library.deleteBody: Every version of the entry is deleted.
library.deleteConsequences: No published item uses it. A draft that names it is refused when next saved.

designer.title: Form designer
designer.noDraftBody: The designer changes a draft. Make one with New draft, at the top of the page: nobody sees it until you publish it.

layout.wizardHint: A page per section, with Back and Next, then a review before submit.

page.choose: Choose a field or a section to change it.

wizard.choose: Choose a field or a page to change it.

tabs.choose: Choose a field or a tab to change it.

preview.title: Preview
preview.noMembers: This project has no members to preview as: choose another project.
preview.passes: A request with these inputs would pass.
preview.problems_one: A request with these inputs would have {{count}} problem.
preview.problems_other: A request with these inputs would have {{count}} problems.

save.conflict: Draft {{number}} changed elsewhere since you opened it ({{reason}}). Your last changes are not saved.
save.invalid_one: Draft {{number}}: not saved, {{count}} problem to fix
save.invalid_other: Draft {{number}}: not saved, {{count}} problems to fix
save.failed: Draft {{number}}: not saved ({{reason}}); the next change tries again
save.outsideNote: The Definition tab shows these on their lines, with your unsaved changes.

props.waitSaved: Wait until the draft is saved
props.noLibrarySource: The form library has no value source yet: add one under <link>Administration › Form library</link>.
props.noLibraryValidation: The form library has no validation yet: add one under <link>Administration › Form library</link>.
props.olderHint: Version {{version}} is the latest: a new version gives the items naming the entry a draft.
props.parametersLead: A CEL expression each, over what form rules read: <expr/>.
props.ownLead: Its choices come from <source/>: only what the requester may see, which the server checks on submit.
props.givesValue: The source gives the field its value, which the server works out again on submit.
props.givesDefault: The source gives the field its default, which the requester can change.
props.urlHint: A host of RVAV_REST_SOURCE_HOSTS; ${inputs.x} is escaped.
props.secretHint: A stored secret's name, sent as bearer, basic or header.
props.itemHint: Its first match holds the value. Empty: the answer, or its first item.
props.valueInItemHintValue: The field's value. Empty: the item itself.
props.valueInItemHintDefault: The field's default. Empty: the item itself.
props.parentHint: The value of the item it sits under.
props.celValueHintValue: The field's value, from the other inputs.
props.celValueHintDefault: The field's default, from the other inputs.
props.optionsTreeCel: A list of {value, label, meta, parent}: parent is the value of the option it sits under.
props.optionsCel: A list of strings or of {value, label, meta}.
props.valueInstead: A computed value instead of options.
props.searches: The source searches by the typed text
props.searchRest: Its URL or body reads ${search}. Otherwise rvav keeps the options that contain the text.
props.searchCel: Its options expression reads search. Otherwise rvav keeps the options that contain the text.
props.dependsLead: A change to these inputs fetches the values again.
props.keyHint: Names it in messages and in the audit log.
props.title: Title
props.titleHint: What it checks, in a few words.
props.checkHint: Over what form rules read. true, "" or {} passes; false refuses with the refusal message; text refuses with that text; a map {"input": "message"} refuses on those inputs.
props.restUrlHint: A host REST value sources may call; ${inputs.x} is escaped.
props.validHint: A boolean in the answer: $.valid unless given.
props.errorsHint: A map of input to message, or a list of {field, message}: $.errors unless given.
props.non2xx: An answer other than 2xx refuses the request, saying the check couldn't run: it never passes unchecked.
props.refusalHint: What a refusal without its own message says.
props.showsOn: A message for no input shows on
props.showsOnLead: None ticked: on the form, above the submit button.
props.validationsLead: Checks of the whole form, run on a wizard's review step and on submit, after the form's own checks and before approval. Day-2 actions' forms don't run them.
props.addFromLibrary: Add one from the form library
props.catalogItemHint: Only this item's deployments: its slug.

ruleHint.required: Empty: as the Required box says.
ruleHint.default: Fills the field from other inputs until the requester changes it. It stays editable.
ruleHint.value: The field shows this and can't be changed.

props.failedDefault: In the preview, the default rule failed, so the field has no default: {{error}}
props.failedSourceValue: In the preview, the value source failed, so the field has no value: {{error}}
props.failedSourceDefault: In the preview, the value source failed, so the field has no default: {{error}}
props.failedRule: In the preview, a rule failed and its default was used: {{error}}
props.noUi: This input has no UI field: add it in the YAML.
props.name: Name
props.nameHintAction: The input's key: inputs.{{name}} in rules, and the variable the job or the workflow gets.
props.nameHintItem: The input's key: inputs.{{name}} in rules and the blueprint, which a rename doesn't change.
props.namePattern: A lower-case letter, then letters, digits and _.
props.label: Label
props.addressImageHint: The picture's address: https://…, a path on this site, or upload:<id> for one you upload.
props.addressLinkHint: Where the link goes: https://…, or a path on this site. It opens in a new tab.
props.altHint: What the image shows, read out in its place to those who can't see it.
props.suggestionsHint: One per line: value | label. Requesters can type others too.
props.optionsTreeHint: One per line: value | label | parent's value.
props.initialYaml: Set lists and objects in the YAML.
props.rulesTitle: Rules <muted>(CEL over inputs, environment, project and user)</muted>

flag.secret: Secret: stored encrypted, never shown again, passed to AWX only at launch
flag.expose_to_inventory: A host variable in the AWX inventory

props.tooLarge: {{name}} is larger than 2 MB, the most an image field shows.
props.uploadHint: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, 2 MB at most.
props.acceptHint: Extensions or MIME types, comma-separated: .csv, .pdf, image/*. Needed to publish.
props.maxSizeHint: From 1 to 25 MB; 10 if left empty.
props.moveFieldsFirst: Move or remove its fields first

composite.noParse: The YAML doesn't parse: fix it in the editor to change the steps here.
composite.title: Title
composite.keyFormat: A key of lower-case letters, digits and underscores.
composite.keyHint: Later steps read its outputs as steps.{{key}}.

edit.alias: The alias *{{alias}} names no anchor before it.
edit.notParallel: That step isn't in a parallel group.
edit.gone: That step isn't in the definition any more.
edit.noBranchOnSide: A branch can't be on a side of a branch: give it more cases instead, each with its conditions.
edit.noBranchInGroup: A branch can't run in a parallel group: put it before or after the group.
edit.noGroupOnCatch: A catch path lists steps in order: a parallel group can't be one of them.
edit.noCatchInGroup: A step of a parallel group has no catch path of its own: put it on the group.
edit.noCatchOnCatch: A step of a catch path has no catch path of its own.
edit.noGroupOnSide: A side of a branch lists steps in order: a parallel group can't be one of them.
edit.firstOnCatch: It runs first on its catch path.
edit.lastOnCatch: It runs last on its catch path.
edit.firstOnSide: It runs first on its side.
edit.lastOnSide: It runs last on its side.
edit.alreadyGroup: It already runs at the same time as others.
edit.noWait: It doesn't wait for a time.
edit.noSignal: It doesn't wait for a signal.
edit.loopUndo: A loop has no undo: each pass would need its own. Remove its undo first.
edit.noAsk: It doesn't wait for a person.

out.restJson: What it keeps of its JSON answer
out.waitUntil: The time it waited until, in RFC 3339
out.pollStatus: The status its last check answered, null if none did
out.pollJson: What it keeps of its last answer, null if none
out.pollMet: Whether its condition held: false if its deadline went on
out.branchCase: Which case it took: 1 for the first, 0 if none
out.askAnswered: Whether someone answered: false if its timeout went on
out.loopItems: Each pass's outputs, in the list's order
out.caught: True when it failed and its catch path ran
out.error: What failed: its step and its message

target.byName: Another AWX template, by its name
target.poll: A wait for a condition, polling a REST API
target.signal: A wait for a signal or an event
target.branch: A branch: cases, each with its steps

inputs.body: Steps bind to the form's inputs as <inputs/>, and to the request's <environment/> and <project/>. The form is changed in the Form designer tab.
inputs.none: The form has no inputs yet.

end.rollback: Undo what was built when a step fails
end.rollbackHint: The VMs built are deleted and each step done is undone by its undo, if it has one, the last first.
end.handlerBody: Its steps run in order when a failure nothing catches fails the request, before the undo steps and the rollback: an AWX job, a custom workflow, a REST call or a message.
end.handlerEmpty: None yet: a failure just fails the request.

resource.noVm: It joins the deployment of a VM step before it: add one first.
resource.deleting: Deleting that deployment runs its type's delete step.
resource.only: The only VM step before it
resource.notBefore: not a VM step before it
resource.undo: If a later step fails, its type's delete step undoes it.

step.onSide: On a side of <branch/>: it runs only when that side is taken, and is skipped otherwise.
step.inHandler: In the <handler/>: it runs only when a failure nothing catches fails the request.
step.selectDone: Select Done, whose error handler it is in
step.onCatchOf: On the catch path of <step/>: it runs only if that step fails, and the request goes on.
step.selectCaught: Select {{name}}, whose catch path it is on
step.onGroupCatch: On the catch path of step group {{number}}: it runs only if one of its steps fails, and the request goes on.
step.runsError: What steps can run couldn't be loaded.
step.runsVm: A VM item: its VMs are planned with the request, from the form's inputs.
step.whenVm: A VM step has no condition: its VMs are planned when the request is submitted.
step.whenBranch: A branch has no condition of its own: empty this, and use its cases.
step.whenHint: A CEL condition: the step is skipped when it is false. Empty: it always runs.
step.itemInputs: Its inputs are known once the item it runs is published.
step.notFormInput: Not an input of its form.
step.open: A custom workflow gives what it returns, a custom resource its properties, a wait for a signal what came: write <reads/> as a CEL expression.
step.catchBody: Steps that run in order if it fails; the request then goes on.
step.groupCatchBody: Steps that run in order if a step of its group fails; the request then goes on.
step.catchEmpty: None: if it fails, the request fails.
step.groupCatchEmpty: None: if one fails, the request fails.

undoBy.label: Undone by
undoBy.hint: What runs when a later step fails and the request's changes are undone.
undoBy.addVariable: Add a variable to the undo

rest.urlHint: The host is fixed, and on the allowed hosts. ${...} fills its path or query, escaped.
rest.bodyHint: A CEL expression, sent as JSON. Empty: no body.
rest.secretsError: The stored secrets couldn't be loaded.
rest.secretHint: Sent as a bearer token, basic credentials or a header, as stored.
rest.acceptHint: Others fail the step. Empty: any 2xx.
rest.keepHint: A JSONPath into the answer. Empty: all of it. Later steps read <json/> and <status/>.
rest.pollNote: No answer, a 5xx, a 429 or a 408 only waits for the next check. Another status it doesn't accept fails the step: list a 404 to mean not yet.

question.label: Question
question.optionsHint: What it may be, separated by commas.
question.defaultHint: What it reads if left blank, or if nobody answers.

onTimeout.continue: It goes on with no answer

wait.untilHint: A CEL expression giving a time: a timestamp, or text such as 2027-03-01T22:00:00Z, read as UTC if it has no zone. A time already passed goes on at once.

poll.everyHint: How often it checks: at least 1m.
poll.untilHint: A CEL condition on the last answer: <json/> and <status/>.
poll.deadlineHint: A duration such as 72h, from when it begins.

signal.sent: A signal sent to this request
signal.conditionHint: CEL over the event, as a subscription's condition reads it, and <waiting/>: this request and its steps before this one. Empty: the first event of the topic in the request's project.
signal.name: Signal name
signal.nameHint: Sent to <path/> by someone who manages the project's requests, or with <cli/>.
signal.outputs: What comes is its outputs: later steps read <field/>.
signal.timeoutHint: From 1m to 2160h (90 days), from when it begins.

loop.itemsHint: CEL giving a list of at most 100 items. Each pass reads <each/>, its item, and <index/>, from 0.
loop.atATimeHint: Up to 10. 1: one after the other.
loop.reads: Later steps read <items/>, each pass's outputs in the list's order, and <count/>. A loop has no undo.
loop.repeat: Repeat it for each item of a list

side.empty: No steps yet: it goes on to what comes after the branch.

addTo.catch: Add a step to the catch path
addTo.handler: Add a step to the error handler

branch.casesBody: The first whose condition holds is taken, once: its steps run, and the steps of the other sides are skipped.
branch.titleHint: Said on the graph and in the request's timeline.
branch.whenHint: A CEL condition: true or false.
branch.otherwiseBody: What runs when no case holds.
branch.reads: Later steps read <case/>: 1 for the first case, 0 if none held. They read a step on a side as one <when/> skipped: it is there only if it ran, so ask <has/> first.

notify.groupsHint: Separated by commas. Its known members.
notify.channels: On the channels each of them keeps on: the app, email, Teams and Slack, those set up. If nobody is there to tell when it runs, it goes on and says so.
notify.messageHint: At most {{max}} characters. ${...} fills in a value: text, a number or true or false. It can't show a secret input.
notify.sentOnce: It is sent once. Later steps read <told/>, how many it told, never what it said.

ask.groupHint: Its members, but for the requester.
ask.approversHint: User IDs, separated by commas. Nobody answers their own request unless it asks the requester.
ask.messageHint: Fixed text, for those asked: nothing of the request is filled in.
ask.noQuestions: No questions: they approve or reject, and a reject fails it.
ask.timeoutHint: A duration such as 48h. Empty: it waits until answered.
ask.escHint: They get one more timeout; then the step fails.

variable.format: Letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit.

dialog.description: It runs one of the catalog's items, an AWX template or a custom workflow, calls a REST API, waits for a person, a time, a condition or a signal, sends a message, or branches. Inputs named as the form's are bound to them.
dialog.keyHint: Later steps read its outputs as steps.<key>.
dialog.onSide: It runs on the side {{label}}, after the steps there.
dialog.onCatch: It runs on the catch path, after the steps there.
dialog.onHandler: It runs in the error handler, after the steps there.
dialog.atEndNote: It runs at the end. Select a step first to add one after it or beside it.
